controls.title: Notifications
controls.command: while true; do clear; printf '=== Dock badges (%s) ===\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')"; if [ -z "$(find "$HOME/.cache/vibe/dock-badges.raw" -mmin -0.25 2>/dev/null)" ]; then "$HOME/Project/vibe-dotfiles/bin/dock-badges.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; cat "$HOME/.cache/vibe/dock-badges.raw" 2>/dev/null; sleep 5; done
